newsitem.title: TURKEY: Tourist bus crash in Turkey -- 11 dead.
newsitem.headline: Tourist bus crash in Turkey -- 11 dead.

text.p: A coach carrying German and Dutch holidaymakers plunged down a cliff in southern Turkey on Thursday, killing 11 of the tourists and injuring 19, police said.
The accident happened in Korkuteli, near the popular resort town of Antalya.
"Eleven people died and 19 others are injured," police officer Mehmet Gul told Reuters by telephone from Korkuteli.
He said the bus was carrying around 30 German and Dutch tourists but could not immediately provide details of those killed or injured.
German and Dutch embassy officials said they were checking the reports.
